info.name: Heartz ML API
info.description: Heartz production inference API (API Gateway -> Lambda -> SageMaker). POST /predict with raw WAV bytes. Optional target via ?target=<label>.

request.description: Production base URL for Heartz ML API(auth Required).
Verification mode. Adds ?target=<label> and returns extra fields: match, score/target_confidence, margin, target_rank, threshold, pass_soft, pass_strict.
Classification only. Send raw WAV bytes as the request body (Postman: Body -> binary).
